entries.title: On iPhone and iPad, a tap after scrolling the crew opens the crewmate you tapped
entries.body: Tapping a crewmate right after scrolling the crew on Home could open another crewmate's summary: the one near where your scroll began. A tap now opens the crewmate under your finger as it landed, even while the crew keep moving.
entries.noPicture: The change is which crewmate a tap opens right after a scroll, a sequence of touches that a still picture cannot show.
